author: Linneaus, 1758
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록
habitat: 논, 강, 하천, 호수, 저수지, 갯벌, 해안
summary: 중대백로의 아종으로, 겨울에 우리나라를 찾아오는 겨울철새이다. 논, 강과 하천, 호수, 저수지, 갯벌, 해안 등에서 주로 보이며, 함께 겨울을 나는 다른 백로류와 섞여 있기도 하다. 풀밭이나 물이 얕은 곳에서 물고기, 작은 양서류, 곤충, 물속 생물 등을 잡아먹는다. 목이 꽤 길어서 날 때나 먹이를 먹을 때 긴 목이 두드러진다.

points.en: black legs with pale yellow or orange tibiae

similar.how: 생김새는 비슷하지만 대백로는 겨울에 찾아오는 겨울철새이다.

art.subject: Great Egret (Ardea alba alba), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as seen in Korea from November to March: plumage entirely white, without plumes. Bill long, yellow and dagger-shaped; the dark gape line runs back to a point behind the eye. Bare lores yellow to greenish-yellow. Iris pale yellow. Legs black below the joint, with the bare tibia above it pale yellow to pinkish-orange; feet black.
art.pose: wading in shallow water with its long neck extended, hunting fish
art.scene: Korean winter wetland: shallow reservoir edge beside harvested rice paddies, a few other wintering egrets nearby; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing in shallow water with the neck extended: all-white plumage, very long kinked neck, long yellow bill with the gape line extending behind the eye, yellow lores, black legs with pale yellow-orange tibiae
adult, in flight seen from below: all white, neck folded into a deep bulge, broad wings with slow beats, long black legs trailing far beyond the tail
art.build: Very large, slim white heron, slightly larger and taller-looking than a Grey Heron; the largest white egret in Korea. Very long, thin neck with a distinct kink, often held in a deep S or stretched almost vertically. Bill yellow, long and straight, clearly longer than the head. Legs very long, black below with pale yellowish tibiae. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. In flight slow, deep wingbeats, the neck folded into a deep bulge below the head and the long legs projecting far beyond the tail.
avoid: Do not end the gape line below or in front of the eye (Medium Egret); in this species it runs past the rear of the eye.
Do not paint yellow feet on black legs (Little Egret), or all-black legs with no pale tibia.
Do not paint a black bill or breeding plumes on wintering birds.
Do not paint a short neck or a round head like Cattle or Medium Egret.
